summary.en-US: Make YouTube controls easier to see, click, and keep visible.

description.en-US:
Make YouTube player controls easier to see, click, and keep visible.

New installs start with recommended settings: strong contrast behind the controls, a bigger progress bar, and easier-to-read subtitles. Use "Use recommended settings" to apply them any time, or pick each option yourself: clear or strong-contrast control styles, controls that stay visible, a thicker progress bar that is easier to grab, and a yellow, cyan, or green highlight for the progress bar, handle, icons, and time display.

Easier-to-read subtitles are larger on a solid dark background, with white or yellow text, and apply only when you turn captions on in a video. A larger mouse pointer and keyboard shortcuts make common controls easier to use. Works on youtube.com and in YouTube videos embedded on other sites.

The extension restyles YouTube's existing player controls without moving, cloning, or replacing them. The "Restore YouTube's look" button turns every change off in one click and keeps your choices for later.

No tracking, no accounts, no external requests. Preferences are stored in the browser's extension storage.

version.approval_notes: The package uses no compilation, transpilation, minification, or generated application code. The source files are copied as-is into the Firefox package; only the manifest is adapted for Firefox (scripts/build-firefox.js). Source: https://github.com/dzienisz/youtube-opacity-controller. To test, open a YouTube video (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ), hover the player, and toggle options in the toolbar popup.
